jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un(e) Consultant(e) Snowflake / Talend
confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe déjà présente chez l'un de nos clients grands compte de la région Lilloise.

Vous participerez à la conception, au développement et à l’optimisation de nos pipelines de données dans un environnement moderne basé sur Snowflake et des outils d’intégration de données avec Talend.

Tes missions :

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des flux complexes sur Talend
.
Participer à la modélisation, au chargement et à l’optimisation des données dans Snowflake
.
Assurer la qualité, la performance et la robustesse des processus d’intégration.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data et métier pour comprendre les besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées.
Participer à l’industrialisation, à la documentation et à la mise en production des traitements.
Contribuer aux bonnes pratiques Data et à l’amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Profil recherché

Expérience minimum de 3 ans.

Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux(se) et force de proposition.
Vous aimez travailler en environnement agile.
Vous avez un esprit analytique et un bon sens de la communication.

Compétences requises :

Très bonne maîtrise de la logique des ETL

Maîtrise avancée de Talend Data Intégration

Maîtrise avancée de Snowflake

Solides compétences en SQL
.
Compréhension des architectures Data modernes
(cloud, ELT, data pipelines…).
Connaissance appréciée : Git, CI/CD, Python
.

Notre Entreprise

Logical Conseils est une entreprise des services du numérique spécialisée en Data, basée à Croix, dans le Nord.
Notre rôle est de conseiller et accompagner nos clients dans chaque étape de leur transformation IT. Afin de garantir des solutions adaptées à chaque défi, Logical Conseils s’appuie sur plusieurs pôles clés
, assurant ainsi un suivi sur mesure et stratégique :

Pôle Data Platform
: verticale dédiée aux plateformes de données cloud : GCP/Azure/AWS
Pôle Data Analytics & IA
: Expertise en Data intelligence et IA
Pôle Data Management
: Expertise en Data Gouvernance /MDM
Pôle Recherche et Développement
: Expertise en Data Science

Entreprise à taille humaine, Logical Conseils accompagne les grands comptes de la région. Notre agilité nous permet d'intervenir sur des secteurs variés tels que le Retail, la banque-assurance, l'industrie, les transports ou encore la grande distribution.

Nos valeurs

Au-delà de l’innovation technique et technologique, la véritable innovation à mener dans les entreprises est humaine. Parce-que l’humain est au cœur de toute ambition de performance, nous renversons la pyramide du management pour placer nos employés en tête des priorités de l’entreprise.
Nous sommes convaincus que leur épanouissement est la clé de la réussite collective.
Cela se traduit par un accompagnement de proximité, une communication transparente, des échanges réguliers avec les managers référents, ainsi qu’un suivi structuré de l’évolution professionnelle.
Nous construisons ensemble votre parcours, rythmé par des formations, des certifications et des missions alignées avec vos objectifs, afin d’assurer une progression solide et en phase avec les technologies innovantes du marché.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous évoluerez au sein d'une équipe déjà présente chez l'un de nos clients grands compte de la région Lilloise.
Vous rejoignez une structure qui valorise l'autonomie et l'excellence technique, offrant un cadre où chaque initiative est encouragée

Avantages salariés complémentaires
:
Tickets restaurants : 13€ par ticket
Remboursement à 100 % des abonnements de transports en commun

Comité d'entreprise : Billetterie, cartes cadeaux, loisirs, culture, etc...
Des évènements réguliers : afterwork, soirée d’agence, activités sportives et associatives, etc...

jobs.title: Développeur ETL/ELT hf
jobs.description:
Würth France, une aventure humaine

Groupe familial de dimension mondiale
, Würth est présent dans plus de 80 pays avec plus de 400 sociétés.
Il emploie plus de 88 000 collaborateurs, dont plus de 44 000 en relation directe avec nos clients via nos différents canaux de vente.
Multi-spécialiste de services et de produits de fixation, outillage et consommables d'atelier destinés aux professionnels, avec plus de 4 150 collaborateurs dont 3 100 collaborateurs dédiés à la vente, Würth France consolide sa présence terrain avec plus de 240 points de vente en France et une offre e-commerce complète.

Pour la septième année consécutive, Würth France a obtenu en 2025 le Label Capital de Meilleur Employeur.

Ce que nous attendons de vous

Votre rôle :

Vous serez intégré à l'équipe Développement Digital et Data au sein de la DSI de Wurth France, et aurez pour mission principale de développer et maintenir les flux de données entre les différentes applications et bases de données de l'entreprise.

Vos missions :

· Développer des flux de transfert de données en Python, Bash et PLSQL.
· Faire évoluer la solution ETL en place Airflow 3 en développant des extensions et des solutions spécifiques.
· Maintenir et migrer les flux de données existant basé sur Microsoft SSIS.
· Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre d'une stratégie de gouvernance des données dans l'entreprise.
· Réaliser des cahiers des charges et des études de faisabilité.
· Accompagner les métiers dans les choix d'architecture de données (choix des données pivots, format approprié des données, etc.).
· Concevoir et implémenter des architectures Data Integration et Big Data, selon les besoins métiers.
· Garantir la qualité des données, tant sur le plan technique, que métier.

Votre profil

Vous attestez d'une 1ère expérience (2 ans minimum) dans le domaine du Développement, du Data Engineering, ainsi que dans la gestion de projets (rédaction de cahier des charges, suivi du projet en interne et avec le client, respect des délais et garanti de la qualité des livrables).
Vous possédez de solides connaissances en ETL (Airflow, SSIS ou autres solutions) ainsi qu'en systèmes de gestion de base de données (Oracle et SQL Server).
Vous maitrisez les langages de script tel que Python, Bash, PowerShell et PLSQL.
La connaissance des OS Windows et Linux, ainsi que la maitrise de Git et des principes fondamentaux de la CI/CD sont des atouts.
Vous attestez d'un niveau B2 en anglais (écrit et oral).
Vous êtes analytique et curieux, tant sur les sujets techniques que métiers.
Vous faites preuve d'organisation, d'anticipation, de rigueur et d'autonomie.
Bon communiquant, vous avez la capacité à prendre du recul et à remettre en question les choses.

« Découvrez les avantages Würth France »

Frais de repas
Mutuelle gratuite pour les salariés
Participation aux bénéfices
Avantages CSE
Plan d'intégration, de formation et d'évolution
Politique en faveur de la mobilité interne
Plan Epargne Retraite Obligatoire
Qualité de vie au travail et RSE
Programme de développement des collaborateurs (Würth France Académie-Würth France Formation)
Stabilité financière du groupe

jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Data Engineering based in France.

This is a senior data leadership role responsible for building and scaling the data foundation that powers critical business decisions.

You’ll own the data roadmap, architecture, and company-wide data model while creating a trusted single source of truth for core business information.

The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical involvement, from modernizing legacy pipelines to improving data quality, governance, and observability.

You’ll lead a small engineering team, establish clear priorities, and help engineers grow while staying close to the technical details when needed.

As the business scales, you’ll also guide infrastructure and warehouse efficiency, enterprise system integrations, and platform reliability.

AI will be an important part of the team’s operating model, with opportunities to use AI agents for development, incident investigation, and data quality.

The environment is fully remote, high-trust, fast-moving, and focused on building a durable enterprise-level data function from a strong foundation.

Accountabilities

Own the data roadmap, architecture, and company-wide data model, establishing a trusted single source of truth for core business data.
Modernize and refactor legacy data jobs, reducing technical debt and creating a platform that can scale with business growth.
Ensure data pipelines remain resilient, reliable, accurate, and consistently available to teams across the organization.
Establish and maintain strong data quality, governance, monitoring, and observability practices.
Manage warehouse and infrastructure costs as data volumes and business requirements increase.
Lead the team's intake and sprint-planning process, prioritizing requests according to business impact while adapting to changing priorities.
Lead, coach, and develop a small data engineering team through code reviews, regular feedback, mentorship, and clear growth paths.
Stay hands-on with technical work when required, contributing directly to architecture, engineering, troubleshooting, and platform improvements.
Integrate new enterprise systems, including ERP platforms, into the data warehouse and broader data ecosystem.
Introduce and scale AI-native ways of working, using AI agents for software development, incident investigation, data quality, and engineering productivity.
Promote a pragmatic engineering approach that starts with the business question and selects the simplest technology capable of solving it.
Foster a culture where data integrity and trust are treated as critical, priorities are managed decisively, and engineers are supported in developing into senior contributors and future managers.

Requirements

8+ years of experience in data architecture or data engineering, including at least 3 years of experience leading teams.
Proven experience building and scaling cloud-based data platforms, with BigQuery or a comparable technology.
Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and Python, along with dbt or a similar data modeling framework.
Deep experience with data modeling and the ability to design data structures starting from business concepts and requirements rather than simply from existing tables.
Experience establishing data quality, governance, monitoring, and observability practices that create confidence across the organization.
Experience managing sprint-based intake, prioritization, and delivery for a data team supporting multiple business stakeholders.
Familiarity with ELT platforms such as Fivetran and comparable data integration tools.
Experience working with enterprise systems and data integrations; ERP experience is a plus.
Experience in direct-to-consumer (DTC) or consumer packaged goods (CPG) environments is preferred.
Strong judgment and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance urgent business needs against long-term platform health and technical debt.
Hands-on leadership style with the ability to move between strategic planning, technical problem-solving, and people management.
Strong coaching and communication skills, with a commitment to developing engineers and creating clear paths for professional growth.
Practical experience using AI agents or AI-assisted engineering tools, with an openness to making AI a meaningful part of day-to-day technical workflows.

Benefits

Base salary of $200,000 plus bonus and incentive compensation, depending on experience.
Comprehensive benefits package supporting employee and family well-being.
Strong healthcare benefits coverage.
Generous paid time off.
Wellness and health-focused perks.
Free access to company products.
Fully remote, high-trust working environment.
Biannual company off-sites providing opportunities for in-person connection and collaboration.
Significant ownership and influence over the organization's data strategy and technical foundation.
Opportunities for career growth and meaningful impact while building an enterprise-level data function.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Functional Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Projective Talent, we connect ambitious professionals with challenging environments where they can accelerate their growth and make a real impact.

For one of our leading clients in the financial services
sector, we are looking for a Functional Data Engineer
who wants to play a key role in a large-scale data transformation journey.

You'll join a modern data environment that is evolving towards a Data Mesh architecture, helping teams turn complex data into structured, scalable and future-proof data products. In this role, you act as the link between business stakeholders and technical data engineers, ensuring data requirements are translated into clear models and actionable solutions.

This is the ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking, data modelling and stakeholder interaction.

Your Responsibilities:

Analyse business requirements and translate them into clear data solutions.
Identify, assess and document data sources across multiple domains.
Design and maintain logical data models and data structures.
Collaborate closely with Technical Data Engineers throughout implementation.
Support the development of modern data products within a Data Mesh environment.
Validate delivered solutions and ensure alignment with business needs.
Drive discussions around data definitions, ownership and quality.
Contribute to data governance and continuous improvement initiatives.
Work with a variety of stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.

Your Skills:

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with a genuine interest in data modelling and stakeholder collaboration.

You have/are

A Master in IT, Engineering, Data, Business Engineering or a related field.
Experience in Data Analysis, Data Modelling, Data Warehousing or a similar domain.
Strong SQL skills.
Good understanding of relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL.
Experience with data modelling concepts and methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
The confidence to challenge stakeholders and drive discussions forward.
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear solutions.
Fluency in English in addition to French/Dutch

Nice to have

Experience with Data Vault modelling.
Knowledge of Data Mesh principles.
Experience with PowerDesigner or similar data modelling tools.
Exposure to Data Governance practices.
Experience working in a large and complex enterprise environment.

Who are we?

Projective Talent is part of Projective Group. We do not do things the typical way. We are not a recruiter and not just a classic consultancy firm. We are a launchpad for ambitious minds. You are in the driver’s seat of your career, and we are here to support your journey.

Here is what you can expect from us.
A competitive salary and a flexible mobility budget, including the option of a company car or bike leasing.
Meal and eco vouchers, an individual training budget, and bonus opportunities because we believe great work should be rewarded.
Entry into one of our Smart Programmes, based on where you are in your career and where you want to grow.
A tailored client match based on your skills, ambitions, and personality.
Coaching throughout your journey by your very own Talent Development Officer, genuinely there to help you thrive.
Regular learning sessions, social events, and a close knit community that always has your back.

After two years of growth, learning, and real impact, you will have the chance to join your client permanently. And do not worry, we are looking forward to welcoming you at one of our regular alumni events.

Sparked your interest?

Want to know more about the role or about us? Hit the apply button and let us have a chat!

new_jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Data Engineering based in France.

This is a senior data leadership role responsible for building and scaling the data foundation that powers critical business decisions.

You’ll own the data roadmap, architecture, and company-wide data model while creating a trusted single source of truth for core business information.

The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical involvement, from modernizing legacy pipelines to improving data quality, governance, and observability.

You’ll lead a small engineering team, establish clear priorities, and help engineers grow while staying close to the technical details when needed.

As the business scales, you’ll also guide infrastructure and warehouse efficiency, enterprise system integrations, and platform reliability.

AI will be an important part of the team’s operating model, with opportunities to use AI agents for development, incident investigation, and data quality.

The environment is fully remote, high-trust, fast-moving, and focused on building a durable enterprise-level data function from a strong foundation.

Accountabilities

Own the data roadmap, architecture, and company-wide data model, establishing a trusted single source of truth for core business data.
Modernize and refactor legacy data jobs, reducing technical debt and creating a platform that can scale with business growth.
Ensure data pipelines remain resilient, reliable, accurate, and consistently available to teams across the organization.
Establish and maintain strong data quality, governance, monitoring, and observability practices.
Manage warehouse and infrastructure costs as data volumes and business requirements increase.
Lead the team's intake and sprint-planning process, prioritizing requests according to business impact while adapting to changing priorities.
Lead, coach, and develop a small data engineering team through code reviews, regular feedback, mentorship, and clear growth paths.
Stay hands-on with technical work when required, contributing directly to architecture, engineering, troubleshooting, and platform improvements.
Integrate new enterprise systems, including ERP platforms, into the data warehouse and broader data ecosystem.
Introduce and scale AI-native ways of working, using AI agents for software development, incident investigation, data quality, and engineering productivity.
Promote a pragmatic engineering approach that starts with the business question and selects the simplest technology capable of solving it.
Foster a culture where data integrity and trust are treated as critical, priorities are managed decisively, and engineers are supported in developing into senior contributors and future managers.

Requirements

8+ years of experience in data architecture or data engineering, including at least 3 years of experience leading teams.
Proven experience building and scaling cloud-based data platforms, with BigQuery or a comparable technology.
Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and Python, along with dbt or a similar data modeling framework.
Deep experience with data modeling and the ability to design data structures starting from business concepts and requirements rather than simply from existing tables.
Experience establishing data quality, governance, monitoring, and observability practices that create confidence across the organization.
Experience managing sprint-based intake, prioritization, and delivery for a data team supporting multiple business stakeholders.
Familiarity with ELT platforms such as Fivetran and comparable data integration tools.
Experience working with enterprise systems and data integrations; ERP experience is a plus.
Experience in direct-to-consumer (DTC) or consumer packaged goods (CPG) environments is preferred.
Strong judgment and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance urgent business needs against long-term platform health and technical debt.
Hands-on leadership style with the ability to move between strategic planning, technical problem-solving, and people management.
Strong coaching and communication skills, with a commitment to developing engineers and creating clear paths for professional growth.
Practical experience using AI agents or AI-assisted engineering tools, with an openness to making AI a meaningful part of day-to-day technical workflows.

Benefits

Base salary of $200,000 plus bonus and incentive compensation, depending on experience.
Comprehensive benefits package supporting employee and family well-being.
Strong healthcare benefits coverage.
Generous paid time off.
Wellness and health-focused perks.
Free access to company products.
Fully remote, high-trust working environment.
Biannual company off-sites providing opportunities for in-person connection and collaboration.
Significant ownership and influence over the organization's data strategy and technical foundation.
Opportunities for career growth and meaningful impact while building an enterprise-level data function.

new_jobs.title: Data Engineer junior – SSIS / SQL Serve - Marseille
new_jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un Data Engineer junior
pour développer et maintenir des flux de données. Le cœur du poste est la maîtrise opérationnelle de SSIS et SQL Server
.

Missions

Développer et maintenir des packages SSIS.
Créer et optimiser des requêtes, procédures et routines SQL Server.
Intégrer des données provenant de plusieurs sources et contribuer à l’alimentation d’un entrepôt de données.
Contrôler la qualité des données, résoudre les anomalies et suivre les traitements en production.
Documenter les flux et les développements réalisés.
Participer ponctuellement à des développements en .NET Core et Angular.

Profil candidat:

Profil recherché

Vous avez une première expérience professionnelle en développement décisionnel ou en data engineering, avec une pratique concrète de SSIS et SQL Server
. Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge des développements sur ces outils avec autonomie.

La connaissance de Power BI
est appréciée. Un anglais professionnel
est requis. Une expérience en .NET Core ou Angular constitue un plus.

new_jobs.title: Functional Data Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At Projective Talent, we connect ambitious professionals with challenging environments where they can accelerate their growth and make a real impact.

For one of our leading clients in the financial services
sector, we are looking for a Functional Data Engineer
who wants to play a key role in a large-scale data transformation journey.

You'll join a modern data environment that is evolving towards a Data Mesh architecture, helping teams turn complex data into structured, scalable and future-proof data products. In this role, you act as the link between business stakeholders and technical data engineers, ensuring data requirements are translated into clear models and actionable solutions.

This is the ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking, data modelling and stakeholder interaction.

Your Responsibilities:

Analyse business requirements and translate them into clear data solutions.
Identify, assess and document data sources across multiple domains.
Design and maintain logical data models and data structures.
Collaborate closely with Technical Data Engineers throughout implementation.
Support the development of modern data products within a Data Mesh environment.
Validate delivered solutions and ensure alignment with business needs.
Drive discussions around data definitions, ownership and quality.
Contribute to data governance and continuous improvement initiatives.
Work with a variety of stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.

Your Skills:

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with a genuine interest in data modelling and stakeholder collaboration.

You have/are

A Master in IT, Engineering, Data, Business Engineering or a related field.
Experience in Data Analysis, Data Modelling, Data Warehousing or a similar domain.
Strong SQL skills.
Good understanding of relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL.
Experience with data modelling concepts and methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
The confidence to challenge stakeholders and drive discussions forward.
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear solutions.
Fluency in English in addition to French/Dutch

Nice to have

Experience with Data Vault modelling.
Knowledge of Data Mesh principles.
Experience with PowerDesigner or similar data modelling tools.
Exposure to Data Governance practices.
Experience working in a large and complex enterprise environment.

Who are we?

Projective Talent is part of Projective Group. We do not do things the typical way. We are not a recruiter and not just a classic consultancy firm. We are a launchpad for ambitious minds. You are in the driver’s seat of your career, and we are here to support your journey.

Here is what you can expect from us.
A competitive salary and a flexible mobility budget, including the option of a company car or bike leasing.
Meal and eco vouchers, an individual training budget, and bonus opportunities because we believe great work should be rewarded.
Entry into one of our Smart Programmes, based on where you are in your career and where you want to grow.
A tailored client match based on your skills, ambitions, and personality.
Coaching throughout your journey by your very own Talent Development Officer, genuinely there to help you thrive.
Regular learning sessions, social events, and a close knit community that always has your back.

After two years of growth, learning, and real impact, you will have the chance to join your client permanently. And do not worry, we are looking forward to welcoming you at one of our regular alumni events.

Sparked your interest?

Want to know more about the role or about us? Hit the apply button and let us have a chat!
